get.summary: Read managed connection metadata
get.description: Admin Console only. Requires the dedicated admin session; developer JWT/bearer, organization role, and forged platform_operator headers are not accepted. The platform organization comes from the server-side admin account. Default-off credential foundation; not payment/shipping execution. Platform operator only, not organization owner/admin. Without a connection, mode=external and connection=null. A revoked connection retains mode=emisell_managed with status=revoked. Never returns provider secrets or runtime tokens; query parameters are rejected.

200.description: Committed result; Cache-Control: no-store. Never record secret-bearing responses.

500.description: Storage, encryption or audit failure; no credentials are returned.

503.description: extension_connections_disabled: EXTENSION_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED is false (default).

put.summary: Provision or replace a managed extension credential
put.description: Admin Console only. Requires the dedicated admin session; developer JWT/bearer, organization role, and forged platform_operator headers are not accepted. The platform organization comes from the server-side admin account. Default-off credential foundation; not payment/shipping execution. Platform operator only. Requires active app/organization/installation, environment entitlement, extension present in the installed immutable snapshot and not disabled, and scopes in both merchant grants and installed version. Encrypts purpose-bound credential; stores only SHA-256 runtime-token digest. Returns runtime token once after commit. 16 KiB body limit; unknown fields/query selectors rejected. No automatic retry: after an uncertain response, GET current revision then rotate. This grants trusted-runtime credential access, not authority to execute a business operation.

200.description: Committed result; Cache-Control: no-store. Never record secret-bearing responses.

500.description: Storage, encryption or audit failure; no credentials are returned.

503.description: extension_connections_disabled: EXTENSION_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED is false (default).

delete.summary: Revoke connection and erase stored credential
delete.description: Admin Console only. Requires the dedicated admin session; developer JWT/bearer, organization role, and forged platform_operator headers are not accepted. The platform organization comes from the server-side admin account. Default-off credential foundation; not payment/shipping execution. Platform operator only. Requires current revision. Revocation remains possible after app/installation deactivation. Clears ciphertext and token hash; metadata and audits remain. Does not rotate the upstream provider key or erase credentials previously fetched by the runtime.

204.description: Revoked; token hash and ciphertext removed.

500.description: Storage, encryption or audit failure; no credentials are returned.

503.description: extension_connections_disabled: EXTENSION_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED is false (default).

post.summary: Rotate a bound runtime token
post.description: Admin Console only. Requires the dedicated admin session; developer JWT/bearer, organization role, and forged platform_operator headers are not accepted. The platform organization comes from the server-side admin account. Default-off credential foundation; not payment/shipping execution. Platform operator only; active connection/lifecycle required and current revision. Keeps provider secret, invalidates previous runtime token immediately, returns replacement once after commit. Rotation is not upstream provider-key rotation.

200.description: Committed result; Cache-Control: no-store. Never record secret-bearing responses.

500.description: Storage, encryption or audit failure; no credentials are returned.

503.description: extension_connections_disabled: EXTENSION_CONNECTIONS_ENABLED is false (default).

post.summary: Resolve the authenticated runtime's extension credential
post.description: Default-off credential foundation; not payment/shipping execution. Machine-only: er_ runtime bearer; OAuth installation tokens, control-plane tokens, Cookie and Origin headers are rejected. Request contains only scope; all identities derived from token, identity override headers ignored and query/body selectors rejected. Checks current lifecycle, installed snapshot, grant intersection, configured scope availability, expiry and connection binding. Successful access audit must commit before plaintext is returned. TLS/trusted internal network required outside loopback development. Runtime must not persist/cache/log responses or expose secrets to frontend. This API cannot guarantee safety of credentials already copied out of the runtime.

200.description: Committed result; Cache-Control: no-store. Never record secret-bearing responses.

429.description: Per-process rate limit: 120 requests/minute per socket IP, maximum 10,000 buckets; forwarded IP headers ignored. Configure edge limits for multiple replicas.

put.description: Admin Console only. Requires the dedicated admin session; developer JWT/bearer, organization role, and forged platform_operator headers are not accepted. The platform organization comes from the server-side admin account. Operator-only publication fails unless the app, organization, HTTPS launch URL, available scopes and immutable active version are eligible. Listing revision is checked. Admin UI additionally sends expectedAppRevision and expectedActiveVersionId from inspection; supply both or neither. Stale inspection returns 409. All callers bind service validation to the locked app/version in the transaction. Existing published catalogs still follow the active version; this is not a new version-pinning or production-approval workflow. Changes are audit logged.

post.summary: Create a merchant-bound development install invitation
post.description: Accepts only Merchant ID, resolves the merchant context internally, verifies that the app status is Development, and returns the provider launch URL. Released apps install through the Emisell App Store. Merchant ID is an addressing input, not authority; the matching merchant session, compatible active credential, PKCE S256, exact callback, and consent remain mandatory. Scopes must be available, except read_products when APP_ENV=development, the Resource adapter is configured/enabled, and the internally sandbox-context merchant is in EMISELL_RESOURCE_TEST_MERCHANT_IDS. This exception does not enable public catalog publication or other planned scopes. HTTPS is required by default; DEVELOPMENT_LOOPBACK_APP_HTTP=true permits only exact loopback HTTP app URLs in development. See examples/product-reader/README.md for the isolated lab.

get.summary: List products for the signed merchant tenant
get.description: Operator-enabled read_products pilot, disabled by default. Authenticate using an installation token from /oauth/token. Merchant comes exclusively from the verified installation; do not send merchantId, merchant_id, store_id or environment selectors. Unknown/duplicate query parameters are rejected. Public scope availability remains planned until rollout review; do not publish apps depending on this scope. Lists base product fields only; no variants or product webhooks. updatedAfter accepts UTC Z timestamps with up to three fractional digits. Cursor is tied to installation and unchanged filters; concurrent edits are not snapshot-isolated.

Issued invoices stay payable. Existing prepaid access lasts until paidThrough if installation remains active. No automatic refunds. Deactivation does not cancel billing; uninstall does.

put.summary: Synchronize the merchant monthly app-billing cycle
put.description: Default off: APP_BILLING_ENABLED=false; live fees also require APP_BILLING_LIVE_ENABLED=true in production. Gated implementation, not an activated payment workflow. See docs/app-billing.md. Server-to-server only. Authenticated merchant/environment are derived from the short-lived RS256 Emisell assertion with apps.billing.write permission, never from request JSON. Cookies, Origin and query parameters are rejected. Current 27–32-day monthly interval only, whole seconds, same currency, consecutive revisions. Annual store plans need a separately supplied monthly app-billing cycle.

See docs/app-billing.md. Server-to-server only. Authenticated merchant/environment are derived from the short-lived RS256 Emisell assertion with apps.billing.write permission, never from request JSON. Cookies, Origin and query parameters are rejected. Returns only the app portion. No provider request is sent. Invoice ID/cycle/currency are immutable; retry returns the same lines. One charge per subscription/period; another invoice cannot claim the same charge. Call before creating the combined provider payment request.

200.description: Freeze app line items for an Emisell invoice

Authenticated merchant/environment are derived from the short-lived RS256 Emisell assertion with apps.billing.write permission, never from request JSON. Cookies, Origin and query parameters are rejected. Persisted Emisell payment only. Exact app amount and currency required. Stable event IDs deduplicate callbacks. Failed can become paid, paid cannot become failed. Payment of an old invoice never reactivates a cancelled subscription or uninstalled app.

get.summary: Inspect app configuration and integration evidence
get.description: Read-only inspection from persisted app/version configuration, official scope catalog, organization entitlement, credential metadata and the first 100 installations. No external HTTP calls, credentials, raw URLs, extension configuration, merchant identity, webhook payload or secret is returned. No query parameters accepted. Cache-Control: private, no-store. This is not a readiness score, production approval, atomic snapshot or end-to-end test; errors must not be converted into a passing result. App revision/version changes during inspection return 409. app.read within the authenticated active organization; organization cannot be selected via query.

200.description: Observed configuration; not proof of successful integration.

500.description: An inspection dependency failed. No result is returned; refresh after resolving the failure.

Reading/selecting capabilities never grants scopes or activates execution. Existing payment/shipping/custom wire types and listing categories are unchanged. No merchant data, credentials or internal runtime URLs. Cache-Control: no-store.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Short-lived Bearer runtime JWT issued by App Platform for one operation and one installation-extension binding.

headers.name: X-Emisell-Invocation-Id
headers.description: Unique invocation identifier generated by App Platform and echoed by the provider.

headers.name: X-Emisell-Idempotency-Key
headers.description: Required only by mutation operation policy. Rate calculation deduplication and provider quota control remain inside API Kurir.

headers.name: X-Emisell-Deadline
headers.description: Absolute RFC3339 deadline. Provider must stop work after it expires.

operations.description: Ask API Kurir to resolve rates for one validated checkout request. API Kurir checks local rate cards and exact snapshots/cache before an optional provider quote, so one calculation does not imply one upstream hit.
Create one shipment after Emisell business validation; the provider result is not the source of truth for order state.
Read normalized tracking for an existing provider shipment reference.
Initialize a provider payment session while Emisell retains transaction ownership.
Process an approved payment action without accepting merchant or amount overrides from the provider.
Cancel a provider payment session using the same installation and transaction binding.
Request a refund against an Emisell-authorized amount and transaction reference.

invariants: Merchant, installation, extension, installed version, environment and operation are derived by trusted services; providers cannot select another tenant.
The dispatcher resolves only the reviewed runtime URL from the installed immutable snapshot and applies destination policy before network access.
A valid token still requires active app, installation and extension state at dispatch time; uninstall or suspension fails closed.
No automatic retry is allowed in v1. A caller may repeat only with the same idempotency key after checking the recorded result.
Payment and shipping business state remains owned by Emisell Backend; provider responses are validated inputs, not authoritative state transitions.
Rate calculation is optional per shipping extension. API Kurir owns cache, request coalescing, provider quota and fallback; App Platform never forces one RajaOngkir hit per checkout.

post.summary: Calculate merchant shipping rates through API Kurir
post.description: Internal Emisell Backend → App Platform bridge, disabled by default. Merchant and environment come only from the verified short-lived Emisell Backend token; the body cannot select a merchant, courier, app, installation, extension, credential, provider or runtime URL. App Platform requires exactly one active installed shipping extension whose immutable version declares shipping.rates.calculate. API Kurir owns service/provider selection, rate card and exact snapshot/cache lookup, request coalescing, quota ledger and optional provider quote. One request does not imply one RajaOngkir hit. No automatic retry.

200.description: Normalized API Kurir result. data may be empty; it never means a free rate.

400.description: Invalid signed merchant context or rate input.

409.description: Shipping/extension unavailable or more than one eligible extension; no arbitrary extension is selected.

422.description: API Kurir has no eligible rate for this request.

429.description: Temporary internal rate limit; honor Retry-After.

502.description: Provider or API Kurir upstream authentication failed; secret details are redacted.

503.description: Bridge disabled/unavailable or provider daily quota exhausted. Do not retry automatically.

ExtensionRuntimeToken.description: Managed Emisell runtime only. One expiring, rotatable token bound to one app installation and extension; not an OAuth installation token, control-plane JWT, merchant ID or developer credential.

bearerAuth.description: API and development fallback authentication. Production requires an RS256 JWT with trusted iss, aud, sub, organization_id, role, iat, and exp claims.

sessionCookie.name: emisell_session
sessionCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly browser session. Only its SHA-256 digest is stored server-side. Unsafe requests also require X-CSRF-Token.

oauthClientBasic.description: Confidential OAuth client ID and client secret. Send only over HTTPS and never from browser code.

installationToken.description: Short-lived opaque token issued by the OAuth token endpoint. It authorizes only its active merchant installation and effective granted scopes.

merchantSessionCookie.name: emisell_merchant_session
merchantSessionCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly merchant browser session stored as a SHA-256 digest. It is separate from the developer session and unsafe requests require X-CSRF-Token.

emisellBackendBearer.description: Short-lived server-to-server identity assertion signed by Emisell Backend. Production validates a dedicated issuer, audience, key ID, signature, jti, store identity, environment, and permissions. Never expose this token to browser code.

adminSessionCookie.name: emisell_admin_session
adminSessionCookie.description: Opaque HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Admin Console session. Accepted only by Admin endpoints and never by Developer or Merchant APIs.

OrganizationId.name: X-Organization-Id
OrganizationId.description: Required for bearer authentication. Browser sessions use their server-side active organization instead.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Double-submit token paired with the server-side browser session.

ResourceLimit.name: limit
ResourceLimit.description: Maximum number of products to return.

ResourceCursor.name: cursor
ResourceCursor.description: HMAC-signed opaque cursor returned by the previous page, bound to merchant, installation, environment and filters. Clients must not create or parse it. Changing cursor keys invalidates existing cursors.

ResourceUpdatedAfter.name: updatedAfter
ResourceUpdatedAfter.description: Return products updated strictly after this UTC timestamp (Z suffix, up to three fractional digits). Use the same filters when continuing a cursor; pagination is not a snapshot of concurrent edits.

x-emisell-gateway-integrations.title: Shipping rate calculation
x-emisell-gateway-integrations.summary: Backend Emisell asks App Platform to authorize one merchant-bound shipping calculation, then App Platform forwards the normalized input to API Kurir. App Platform is not the shipping engine.

sequence.action: Authenticate checkout and merchant, then issue a short-lived assertion.
Verify identity, permission, installation lifecycle and immutable shipping capability.
Resolve merchant shipping configuration, rate card, snapshot/cache and quota policy.
Called by API Kurir only when its policy requires an optional provider quote.

hops.label: Hop 1 · authorization gateway
hops.authentication: Short-lived signed Emisell Backend assertion with shipping.rates.calculate permission.
hops.identity: Merchant ID and environment come only from the verified assertion.

hops.label: Hop 2 · private shipping gateway
hops.authentication: Server-only API Kurir service key provisioned through the deployment secret manager.
hops.identity: App Platform forwards the authenticated merchant and sandbox/live mode in private headers.

ownership.rule: App Platform never accepts merchant identity from request JSON.
Exactly one active installed immutable shipping extension must declare shipping.rates.calculate.
No caller-controlled selector is forwarded by App Platform.

ownership.concern: Rate card, snapshot/cache and request coalescing
ownership.rule: A calculation does not imply one upstream provider hit.
App Platform does not retry automatically or bypass quota policy.
A returned rate is input to Emisell business logic, not an authoritative order transition.

failurePolicy: Fail closed before API Kurir when assertion, permission, installation, version or capability is invalid.
Reject ambiguous eligible shipping extensions instead of choosing one arbitrarily.
Limit upstream response size, validate the normalized schema and redact private upstream messages.
Do not convert timeout, quota exhaustion or provider failure into an empty successful rate list.
Do not retry automatically. Preserve X-Request-ID for correlation without logging credentials.
sandboxChecklist: Keep API_KURIR_RATES_ENABLED=false until a synthetic sandbox merchant and one eligible extension are ready.
Provision API Kurir origin and service key only in the App Gateway secret environment.
Make api-service mint shipping.rates.calculate only from an authenticated merchant/checkout context.
Verify rate-card/cache hit, optional provider miss, timeout, malformed response, quota, suspend and uninstall paths.
Confirm no API Kurir key, provider credential, customer address or full payload appears in browser, docs, logs or traces.
Enable production separately after egress, rotation, monitoring and entitlement review.
